why: The quiet reach at the end of the hall asked to be announced after all, with its title taken away: `announcement: shown` on an objective with no `title` is an announcement with nothing to announce. The emitter prints the title as the `New objective` line, so without one there is no line, no cue and no completion message, and the declaration binds to nothing - which is the vacuous shape, refused rather than ignored. The sidecar follows the title out so the inventory stays exact. It declares no unit: `announcement` and both visibilities are bound in the gallery proper; what must not compile is the combination of an opt-in and nothing to opt into.
